newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Expressway earns 137 mln yuan in '96.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Expressway earns 137 mln yuan in '96.

text.p: Guangdong Provincial Expressway Development Co Ltd notched up net profits of 137.46 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange announced after the close of trade on Wednesday.
Earnings per share were 0.31 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 220.6 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.

The company posted net profits of 118.48 million yuan on turnover of 184.99 million yuan for 1995 on international standards, according to the firm's B share listing announcement published in August 1996.
Based on Chinese standards, it posted net profits of 120.81 million yuan on turnover of 189.3 million yuan for 1995, the listing announcement said.
The company proposed to distribute 1.7 bonus shares for every 10 B shares based on profits racked up in the June-December period of 1996, the exchange said.
It also proposed to distribute 3.3 bonus shares for every 10 B shares based on capital surplus, it said.
Trading in the company's B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning for the annual result announcement and resume in the afternoon, it said.
